text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That graded stakes race
took place a few weeks before the Yayoi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Duramente, what incredible speed!
She's chasing down fiercely! Closing in from the outside!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: But she can't reach! The leader holds on to take the win!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Duramente came in 2nd!?
No way! Whaaaaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Ah. Maybe she wasn't feeling well. Besides, look, the girl who took 1st place is really capable too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Even in the Classics, if 'things go right',
Duramente can take 1st place!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Graded races held during this time of year hold a profound meaning for the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Classic Races" are about to begin.
It is also a place where one is tested
to see if they are worthy of challenging for that noble crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown, who is set to run in the Yayoi Sho,
will also undergo that inspection.
choice_data_list: ...From here on is the critical moment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Right after the Yayoi Sho,
the Classic races will kick off—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I will be taking on the Satsuki Sho in April,
and the Nippon Derby in May.
We are in agreement on that, correct?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, each of the next three months
will bring a crucial turning point.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To ride this momentum,
I want to secure a solid victory in the Yayoi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"The home stretch at Nakayama Racecourse, the stage for the Yayoi Sho,
measures 310 meters."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If she wants to turn it into a late-race burst showdown,
she should start spurting before the home stretch, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The other girls will probably be thinking the exact same thing.
It might get pretty crowded around the fourth corner.
choice_data_list: Then should we make our move from the third corner before that?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Right. I'll keep that in mind as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The racecard is out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown and I approach Satono Diamond, who holds the data.
The opponents in the lineup for the Yayoi Sho are—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Well now, graded stakes winners
as far as the eye can see."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four...
...They're still there.
choice_data_list: With so many skilled contenders gathered, it's going to be a fierce battle...
With so many skilled contenders gathered, it's going to be a fierce battle...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Do you really think that's enough to beat me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Yayoi Sho is finally kicking off...!
That girl who did so well in the Junior GⅠ is running too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! It looks like it's gonna be an extremely high-level race.
The Umamusume who wins here will probably—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: —She's the closest one to becoming a Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Now, let us be off.
